I could not verify the literature from memory, so this rests on partial recall. Braun and Oréfice-Okamoto (2016) are usually cited for injectivity when $\deg p \le 4$. I'm not confident a non-injective example with $\deg p = 5$ exists, which Solution 3 asserts and Solution 1 contradicts with its claim that $\deg p \le 5$ suffices. Solution 2's argument for $k=3$ is sketchy and does not address the degree-4 result.
